### Ubiquitous language (summary)

Canon clusters: **Pin → Thread → Hunch → Canvas → Quilt**, layers **Raw Source / Evidence Ledger / Domain Graph / Compiled Page / Research Schema**, entities including first-class **Claim** + **Hypothesis**, epistemic enum **Verified…Unknown**, ops **Ingest / Query / Compare / Synthesize / Promote / Revise / Lint**.

Hard retirements: Triple/Quinuple RAG → **Hybrid Retrieval**; Theory → **Hypothesis/Hunch**; case_file → **Raw Source/Document**; Xata → **Neon**.

Biggest ambiguity: three epistemic dialects (CORPUS / mindmap brackets / liturgy UX).

---

### RAG pipeline vs blueprint

| Blueprint step | Platform reality |
| --- | --- |
| Ingest | `disclosure-rag` → `packages/knowledge-base/sources/*`; Neon path = `packages/db/scripts/rebuild/ingest.py` |
| Vector DB | Neon pgvector @ 1536 (`text-embedding-3-small`) for Next.js; disclosure-rag also has 384d MiniLM / Upstash / FAISS / OpenAI VS |
| Retrieval | Live: FTS + embed via `executeDatabaseSearch` + optional `file_search` |
| Chat API | Mindmap + Prometheus — **not** disclosure-rag `:8000` |
| CORPUS ledger/claims/promote | Spec only |

`STATUS.md` “production Quinuple / Xata / Next integrated” is **false** against code.
